admission.claim: The request buffer is read from the socket and accepted as a PROXY v2 header when it begins with the \r\n\r\n signature, even when fewer than sizeof(struct proxy_header_v2) bytes have been received.
admission.observation: read_request_finalizer returns FINALIZER_DONE as soon as \r\n\r\n is found in the buffer (total_read >= 4), so parse_proxy_protocol dispatches to parse_proxy_protocol_v2 with a buffer that may contain far fewer bytes than the 52-byte struct proxy_header_v2.

root.claim: parse_proxy_protocol_v2 casts the undersized buffer to struct proxy_header_v2* and dereferences fields (hdr->len, hdr->cmd_ver, hdr->fam, hdr->addr.*) at offsets beyond the actual bytes read, reading uninitialized/out-of-bounds data.
root.observation: The buffer is cast to struct proxy_header_v2* and fields at offsets 12-51 are read even when only 4 or more (but fewer than 52) bytes were actually received.

propagation.claim: The public issue and inspected source do not establish a distinct, independently observable propagation stage.

target.claim: The authoritative issue-relevant runtime violation occurs.
